```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(plm)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
data <- readxl::read_excel("D:\\NSC\\2023 Data Panel NTT Ketahanan Pangan.xlsx")
head(data)
```

```{r}
pdata <- pdata.frame(data, index = c("Kab","Tahun"))
head(pdata)
```

```{r}
# Model FEM (Fixed Effect)
fem <- plm(IKP ~ AHH  + PDRB + Prod.Pangan, data=pdata, model="within")
summary(fem)
```

```{r}
# Model REM (Random Effect)
rem <- plm(IKP ~ AHH  + PDRB + Prod.Pangan, data=pdata, model="random")
summary(rem)
```

```{r}
# Uji Chow (Pooled vs FEM)
pooling <- plm(IKP ~ AHH  + PDRB + Prod.Pangan, data=pdata, model="pooling")
pFtest(fem, pooling)

# Uji Hausman (FEM vs REM)
phtest(fem, rem)
```

```{r}
# Lagrange Multiplier Test (LM Test) 
plmtest(pooling, type = "bp")
```


```{r}
# --- Uji Asumsi Klasik ---

# Multikolinearitas (VIF)
vif(lm(IKP ~ AHH  + PDRB + Prod.Pangan, data=data))

# Normalitas residual
resid_rem <- residuals(rem)
shapiro.test(resid_rem)
tseries::jarque.bera.test(resid_rem)

# Heteroskedastisitas (Breusch-Pagan)
bptest(rem)
```

```{r}
# Standardisasi residu ke Z-score
resid_std <- (resid_rem - mean(resid_rem)) / sd(resid_rem)

# Kolmogorov–Smirnov Test terhadap Normal(0,1)
ks.test(resid_std, "pnorm", mean=0, sd=1)
```
